sens_en: to call, to be called, to shout
origine_fr: La bouche 口 et 丩. La bouche crie, et 丩 donnait le son, mais il se lit jiū, loin de jiào. Du cri on passe à l'appel : appeler quelqu'un, et s'appeler d'un nom.
origine_en: The mouth 口 and 丩. The mouth shouts, and 丩 gave the sound, but it reads jiū, far from jiào. From shouting came calling: to call someone, and to be called by a name.

mots.en: to be named, to be called
